title: Townsend Brown in the Bahamas with William Stephenson

tellings.quote: He also spent an inordinate amount of time in the Bahamas with the inspiration for James Bond and Winston Churchill super spy William Stephenson.

plain: Thomas Townsend Brown, a man at the centre of Michels's story of secret science, spent an unusual amount of time in the Bahamas with William Stephenson, a spy for Winston Churchill and said to be an inspiration for James Bond. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as a sign that Brown moved in intelligence circles.
